sara_mktg: Hey runtime team — prepping a short campaign blurb and need a tiny, reproducible bench to validate our launch claim. Can you run a smokepack targeting the quantized MANA-7B-v2 variant and share p50/p95/p99 + raw token throughput?

eli_runtime: Yep, can do. Quick clarifying q's: which quantization profile (int8 / q4_0 / q4_k)? what hardware (A10G / A100 / V100)? and do you need warmup traffic simulated? :mag:

sara_mktg: Thanks! Use q4_0 (we're highlighting smaller-footprint deploys). Target A10G for the hosted numbers. Yes please include a warmup sweep (5 requests at short context) then the 100-sample smokepack. Make sure samples include 16/512/2048 token lengths spread.

jamal_eng: Adding a quick run snippet for the job config — copy/paste on your side if helpful:

```
model: mana-7b-v2-quantized-q4_0
hardware: A10G
warmup: {requests:5, seq_len:32}
samples: samples.json  # 100 items with 16/512/2048 mix
metrics: [p50, p95, p99, tokens_per_sec, cold_start_ms]
logging: raw, traces
```

eli_runtime: Perfect, I will queue this under "marketing-smoke/1715470000". One ask: do you want KV/prefix cache enabled? That changes tail behavior.

sara_mktg: Yes enable prefix/KV cache — we want realistic app-likeliness. Also include a control run with cache disabled (single short run) so we can show delta in the deck.

benchbot: Job queued: marketing-smoke/1715470000 (queued on A10G, q4_0). ETA ~45m. Logs will be pushed to /bench/artifacts/marketing/1715470000/.

eli_runtime: Running now. We'll attach: 1) a CSV with p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per sample, 2) raw request traces (jsonl), 3) a short methodology note describing sampling and warmup. Deliver by EOD unless we hit infra queueing.

sara_mktg: Awesome — if possible, include a 1-slide-ready summary (1–2 bullets + 2 numbers) we can drop straight into the launch deck. Also flag any outlier samples with >2x p95 vs median. :pray:

eli_runtime: Will do. Tagging jamal_eng for quick help if any sample repro fails.

jamal_eng: On standby. If you hit long-tail flakes, run `--seed 42 --repeat 3` to reproduce.

sara_mktg: Thanks team! ping me here with artifact links when ready. :rocket:
